title: Graceful Elegance

outfit_card.silhouette: A layered Rococo-style gown with a heavily gathered bell skirt over a pleated petticoat, a fitted corseted bodice, and an off-shoulder puff-sleeve architecture framed by an ornate gold-trimmed bonnet, creating a balanced and voluminous aristocratic shape.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: A large, wide-brimmed straw bonnet draped in sheer ivory lace, adorned with a prominent cream rose and a trailing silk ribbon bow.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: Bodice of pale gold silk featuring a sweetheart neckline lined with delicate ruffled lace, accented by a dark green velvet ribbon choker, billowing white tulle off-shoulder sleeves, and a structured dark green belt with a pearl buckle.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: A grand three-tiered bell skirt composed of shimmering pale gold fabric, horizontal bands of scalloped lace, and pleated cream underlayers, finished with a dark green scalloped hem, worn with elegant cream stockings and classic heeled pumps.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: Detached sheer white lace gloves, a delicate lace parasol, and intricate rose floral motifs woven into the fabric's golden embroidery and bonnet decorations.
